create_viewer_instance: create a Viewer instance bound to a viser server with a render function and rendering mode
get_camera_state: get the CameraState with fov, aspect ratio, and c2w matrix from a viser client handle
compute_camera_intrinsics: compute the 3x3 camera intrinsic matrix K from a CameraState given image width and height
update_viewer_step: update the viewer with the current training step and number of rays processed per step
complete_training: mark the viewer training as completed and disable all training GUI controls
